svg.title: Crossline: routes and utility lanes
svg.desc: Source-derived top-down plan of Crossline 0.3, ninety-six by one-hundred-sixty metres. Footprints show the actual authored construction pieces; raised routes and ground routes overlap in plan. Blue base is north, red base south. Galleries are four-and-a-half metres high.

g.metadata: Source SHA-256: 95c2d17be4bd57fba3f16809271899dbec05f8ef9ed106ca1d9c56eb4159ea5f; metres Z-up; UE centimetres and yaw converted before projection.
g.text: Room to build. Routes to explore.
96 × 160 m · Red vs Blue bases · native utility demonstration lanes
